reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 2 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Mavericks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Mavericks win 50 times in 100; most games like this end between 208 and 256 total points.

analyst.text: Cleveland are under pressure. Kenny Atkinson publicly questioned the team's effort after a loss to Charlotte, and pundits have started asking about his job. The Cavs lost at Miami on Friday, Evan Mobley missed his first game of the season, and an FAA ground stop disrupted their flight home before this back-to-back. Dallas are looking for a reset after a 133-94 thrashing in Minnesota that Cooper Flagg blamed on mindset, and they get Santi Aldama back to full minutes after knee surgery. With Cleveland tired and distracted, the mood leans slightly towards Dallas.
